sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.excerpt: consuming the previously generated symbols as additional input when generating the next
sources.inspection_note: Model Architecture 與 Encoder and Decoder Stacks：decoder 逐項生成、先前輸出成為下一步輸入；因果遮罩只讓預測依賴已知輸出。這只證明可利用先前文字，不證明中間步驟一定有用。

sources.title: Language Models Don't Always Say What They Think: Unfaithful Explanations in Chain-of-Thought Prompting
sources.excerpt: CoT explanations can systematically misrepresent the true reason for a model’s prediction
sources.inspection_note: Abstract、Introduction、Explanation Faithfulness、Limitations：作者改變提示中的偏置線索，觀察預測改變而解釋不提線索；偏向錯答時仍會產生合理化文字。研究測 GPT-3.5、Claude 1.0 的特定任務，只支持不能預設可見解釋忠實或正確，不支持所有模型每次都不忠實。
